integrity: The rank-one log-determinant optimizer is credited to the source. The new claim is the independent global spectral optimum, sharp disagreement interval, and unbounded regret. No experimental data are presented as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic three-eigenvalue rank-one benchmark with fixed baseline Q=I. Condition-number regret is not a direct CG runtime or iteration-count claim; existence of undiscovered equivalent literature cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp rank-one spectral-conditioning regret of Bregman log-determinant preconditioning
